Nowadays, in many families both the parents working. Some working parents believe 
that other family members such as grand parents can take care o their children, while 
others think that childcare centres provide the best care. Discuss both views and give 
your opinion. A:
In today’s fast-paced era, both parents works in order to earn vitamin M, due to which a 
group of thoughts hold an opinion that grandparents are the only person who can take 
care of the children. Conversely, others believe that childcare centres can nurture or look 
after their children. Both perspectives will be discussed in the forthcoming paragraphs. First and foremost, Grandparents are the ones whom the parents can trust blind-folded. Also, they provide best nurturing, shares their life experiences and also scolds or provide 
guidance if they observe any wrong or misdeed by their grand children. Which helps off-
springs to lead in the right direction. Often, children need someone in their life with whom 
they can share their feelings and can open-up, by becoming friend of their grand children 
they can reserve this space for them which also strengthens the bonding between them. For example, they provide cultural traditions along with moral values during festivals and 
daily activities. On the other hand, Childcare centre has a strict schedule which student has to follow 
anyhow, through which children learns consistency and formalness. Moreover, they plan 
activities through which children develop logical thinking and problem solving skills, 
sharpen their brain. Additionally, by way of interactions with other mates, they can 
improve in the fields including communication, leadership and conflict resolution. Brief but comprehensive, from my perspective, If the grand parents are available and 
healthy in both the ways mentally as well as physically, then fist priority should be given 
to them owing to trust factor, moral and cultural values. Though, childcare centre help 
them to develop real life skills and discipline.
